method: Source-level independent DOM, storage and audio-bridge fixtures; not browser, accessibility-tree, physical-device or acoustic acceptance.

checks.name: Source never touches microphone, legacy store, export, cloud or audio nodes
Startup is read-only; saves while stopped require neither microphone nor audio
Full settings round-trip without losing any supported field and reload persistent data
Load applies values without starting stopped or paused playback; play is explicit and pause wins
A failed application never claims that the set was loaded or selected
Editing is an isolated draft; cancel changes neither the stored set nor playback
Editing updates all values and description only after save, without applying
Selected indicator detects modification and return to exact saved settings
Duplicate and delete require explicit confirmation and do not mutate originals on cancel
Empty/overlong names, descriptions and invalid numeric settings are rejected without truncation
A copied maximum-length name is never silently truncated and remains editable
Every schema field rejects invalid enums, booleans, numeric coercion and unknown future data
Limit 100 rejects creation/duplication and never discards any existing record
Malformed, over-limit, duplicate-ID and future-format stores are never overwritten or silently sliced
Quota/security errors preserve existing records and keep the user draft for retry
Storage read failure is not an empty list, and unverified writes are never reported saved
Concurrent write and storage-event edits preserve the newer record and unsaved draft
Names/descriptions are text-only; language switch retains unfinished values and complete controls
Repeated mount does not duplicate controls or event handlers
